dogecoin.text: Here’s why I hate #dogecoin, it’s a meme that is going to inadvertently financially hurt lots of good people, and even worse, it’s mostly people that really can’t afford it.

Hey @elonmusk, I wasn’t singling you out with this, but considering your latest headline, you might want to point people towards sound money and not a meme that can cost them their life savings. #Elon #dogecoin
Why didn’t El Salvador approve Doge Coin as money? #Bitcoin
